title: American University Emerging Global Leader Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based university scholarship for international undergraduates (renewable)
duration: Four years of undergraduate study (renewable based on continued satisfactory academic performance)
description: The AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship (AU EGLS) is American University's most prestigious award for international undergraduates, covering all billable AU expenses - full tuition, room and board - for international students who need an F-1 or J-1 visa to study in the United States. It is renewable for up to four years based on continued satisfactory academic performance, and any major offered at AU is eligible. title: Jefferson Scholars Foundation Scholarship
program_type: Nominative merit scholarship for University of Virginia undergraduates
duration: Four years of undergraduate study at the University of Virginia
description: The Jefferson Scholarship is a merit award of the Jefferson Scholars Foundation that funds the entire cost of attendance for four years of undergraduate study at the University of Virginia, plus supplemental enrichment experiences. Virginians receive over $42,000 per year (upwards of $230,000 total) and non-Virginians over $83,000 per year (upwards of $405,000 total). Students cannot apply individually: invited secondary schools nominate a senior through the Foundation's nomination portal, with materials due December 1 for all regions. title: King-Morgridge Scholars Program
program_type: Donor-endowed university scholarship for international undergraduates
description: The King-Morgridge Scholars Program is a four-year, full-tuition scholarship at the University of Wisconsin-Madison for international students from Africa, the Caribbean, Latin America, South Asia and Southeast Asia who are committed to applying their talents toward poverty alleviation around the globe. Scholars receive a full-time, four-year/eight-semester award covering tuition and fees, on-campus room and board, health insurance, airfare and a stipend for miscellaneous expenses, with six scholarships awarded each year.
